evidence_boundary: Clears manager state, loads data/sounds/sounds.sfx, allocates 256 pooled 0x88-byte events, registers debug controls, seeds category volumes, and calls the PC device initializer; failure clears initialized state

Walks active events, computes distance attenuation for tracked positions, combines event sub/master volume with manager master and game/menu category scale, stores pre/post-distance volumes, and updates assigned playing channels
Stores the supplied float directly as manager master volume, logs and persists it, then recomputes all event volumes; retained PC source instead applies a nonlinear tangent transform
Walks the sample list, invokes each virtual deleting destructor, and clears the sample head
Returns active events to the pool, frees the pool, deletes all samples, releases backend voice buffers and debug menu, frees the effect list, and clears initialized state

Chooses sound/music path context, creates through the PC backend from path or supplied buffer, optionally reuses a same-name sample, stores defaults/name, links new samples, and marks _L/_R stereo-side variants
Requires initialized state and a nonempty name, performs case-insensitive lookup, optionally reloads an existing entry, and gates missing-sample creation through released load-policy globals
Resolves the named sample through GetOrCreateSample and forwards the complete tracking, once, fade, range, repeat, pitch, completion, owner-position, and category payload to PlaySample
Requires initialized state, suppresses non-repeating samples during pre-running state, enforces once-per-sample/owner when requested, and starts a new event

Allocates and initializes an event, derives initial fade/range/tracking/pitch/owner state, updates spatial position, recycles inaudible non-looping starts, computes volume, starts an assigned channel, and returns the event or null

Static-like released ABI takes event and block flag on the stack, not manager this; invokes the requested owner callback, forwards stop to an assigned PC channel, clears playing, and clears the owner reader
Pops the free-event pool, links at the head or after currently assigned events, increments active count, and returns null with the out-of-events warning when the fixed pool is exhausted

Performs one forward adjacent-swap pass by attenuated volume, limits channel ownership to three quarters of backend capacity, stops assigned events below that budget, and starts unpaused budgeted events when a channel is free
Stops every playing event for an owner through completion callback, nonblocking channel release, playing clear, and owner-reader clear
Stops every playing event matching owner and sample with the ordinary nonblocking stop path
Stops every event matching the sample pointer, forwarding block-until-stopped true for assigned channels, then clears playing and ownership
Matches sample plus owner, stores the fade destination, and chooses positive or negative signed speed from current subvolume versus destination
Stops all active events with requested callbacks, nonblocking channel release, playing clear, and owner-reader clear
Pauses every assigned backend channel and sets each event paused flag
Unpauses every assigned backend channel and clears each event paused flag

Released stack-only ABI updates tracked position/velocity, chooses the nearest multiplayer camera, transforms into camera-local space, handles stereo-side offsets and X inversion, and recalculates pan for followed owners
Finds playing events by case-insensitive sample name plus owner and runs callback/channel release/playing clear/reader clear
Returns the first playing event matching owner and case-insensitive sample name while initialized
Stores desired pitch and round(fade_seconds * 20) pitch-fade ticks on a valid event while initialized
Requires initialized state and delegates name/ordinal lookup to the static effect list

Randomly selects one chained effect variant, scales volume, resolves loop/once and pitch variance, applies language-dependent sample loading, and forwards to PlaySample; released ABI retains an extra owner-position flag
Walks every chained effect variant and active event, matching a playing event by owner and case-insensitive effect sample name

Refreshes camera and backend globals, sorts/arbitrates events, advances pitch and strict-crossing signed fades, updates spatial/volume state, handles owner-death tracking policy and completed channels, then recycles dead events to the pool
Formats the indexed active event as sample/channel, volume/attenuation, tracking mode, and owner/dead-target debug text or no-sound
Builds <root>/data/sounds/sounds_<language>_pc.xap, compares it with the cached +0x88 path, optionally copies the new path, and returns true only when initialized and changed
On a changed language XAP path, updates the cache, returns active events to the pool, stops voices, deletes samples, runs memory cleanup, and reloads the compressed bank
Returns the one-byte global gate consulted by PlayEffect before playback

Skips resource-build or disabled-compressed-sound modes, opens the cached XAP, reads count/name records, creates samples from the stream, updates load progress, and closes the buffer; full XAP schema remains open

Deletes samples, shuts down music and voice playback, releases voice buffers, reinitializes the PC sound device/music, reloads the compressed bank, and refreshes existing sample definitions when enabled
